name: Phishing Campaigns
description: Ability to design, execute, and measure email-based phishing campaigns as part of adversarial simulations. Covers spear-phishing, payload delivery via email, credential harvesting, phishing infrastructure setup, campaign tracking, and metrics collection. Distinct from bulk security awareness phishing (which is a defensive function).

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to phishing campaign execution

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands phishing attack types, delivery mechanisms, and campaign structure
evidence: Completed phishing methodology training
Can distinguish spear-phishing, whaling, and credential harvesting approaches
Understands email authentication mechanisms (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and their relevance

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Executes phishing campaigns using established templates and infrastructure under supervision
evidence: Deployed phishing campaigns using lab infrastructure (e.g., GoPhish) with oversight
Configured email sending infrastructure and landing pages under guidance
Collected and reported campaign metrics with senior review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently designs and executes targeted phishing campaigns
evidence: Designed and executed 3+ spear-phishing campaigns with custom pretexts
Built phishing infrastructure with proper OPSEC and domain ageing
Bypassed email filtering and security controls to achieve inbox delivery
Produced campaign reports with click rates, credential capture rates, and analysis
Handled captured credentials and session tokens under the agreed retention and destruction policy, and reported outcomes in aggregate rather than naming individuals

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Executes sophisticated phishing against hardened targets; develops lab phishing capabilities
evidence: Successfully phished targets with advanced email security (sandbox, AI-based filtering)
Developed custom delivery payloads (e.g., HTML smuggling, container formats) that evade attachment scanning and Mark-of-the-Web controls
Executed adversary-in-the-middle phishing (e.g., Evilginx) to demonstrate MFA bypass within rules of engagement
Built reusable phishing infrastructure automation for the lab
Mentors team on phishing tradecraft and infrastructure setup

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines phishing methodology; researches novel delivery techniques; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's phishing campaign methodology and playbooks
Researched and published novel phishing delivery or evasion techniques
Developed metrics frameworks for measuring organisational phishing resilience
Trains teams and delivers client workshops on phishing defence

assessment_methods.description: Design and execute a phishing campaign against a lab-controlled target environment, assessed on pretext quality, infrastructure OPSEC, delivery success, and reporting
Review phishing campaign reports from recent engagements including pretexts, infrastructure design, and metrics
